snippet.title: Crown of Hispania | Early Access Release Date Announcement Trailer | indie.io
snippet.description:
Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game set in 11th-century Iberia, where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Move armies freely across 300 hand-built provinces, manage a deep medieval economy, and face an AI that actually fights back.

Play the demo and wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3374640/Crown_Of_Hispania/
